title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend
description: P-1327 Unity Catalog Disaster Recovery (UC DR) At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started. The Unity Catalog Disaster Recovery team helps customers keep their Databricks deployments resilient. When a cloud region goes down, our disaster-recovery manager coordinates replication of Unity Catalog metadata and data to a paired region so customers can recover quickly. Based in Berlin, the team works closely with Unity Catalog and Delta teams to ensure platform reliability at scale. The Impact You Will Have Design and build distributed systems that enable disaster recovery and high availability for Unity Catalog metadata and data across cloud regions. Own complex technical projects end-to-end, from design through delivery, testing, and production rollout. Drive technical decisions and contribute to architectural direction for disaster recovery capabilities. Collaborate with Unity Catalog and Delta teams to ensure seamless integration and platform reliability. Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and reliability issues in production systems. What We Look For 5+ years of software engineering experience. Experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems in production environments. Experience with one or more programming languages including Java, Scala, C++, or Go. Understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, including replication, consistency, and fault tolerance. Experience working on a SaaS platform or with service-oriented architectures. Experience with cloud technologies including AWS, Azure, or GCP. Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively across teams. B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. You'll work on systems that enable enterprises to govern data at scale while maintaining performance and usability.
